entries.claim: the build refuses with 'xcrun could not select the macOS SDK (DEVELOPER_DIR=${DEVELOPER_DIR:-unset})' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: an xcrun that cannot select the SDK (a DEVELOPER_DIR without one); assert the refusal before the signing identity

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected policy-witness binary at ${RUNNER_BIN}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a Cargo invocation that omits the controller output; assert the named path and no Meson

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected sandbox-log-observer binary at ${SANDBOX_LOG_OBSERVER_BIN}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a Cargo invocation that omits the observer output; assert the named path and no Meson

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected sbpl-check binary at ${SBPL_CHECK_BIN}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a Cargo invocation that omits sbpl-check; assert the named path and no Meson

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'cargo built ${bin_name} at ${bin_path}, not at ${bin_expected}; a target triple or a Cargo setting moved it' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a Cargo target triple selected through the environment or configuration in a disposable checkout; assert the refusal names the reported path and no copy follows (Cargo must run, so this needs a real or stub Cargo)

entries.claim: the build refuses with '${target} is built for macOS ${minos:-?}; Info.plist declares ${PW_MINIMUM_MACOS}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a real build with one output at another minimum, in both variants; assert the named binary and no assembly (probes A2, A3, B3 in the plan)

entries.claim: Meson refuses a configured directory whose ninja_missing departs from the fixed policy
entries.control: meson configure of a copied directory with the option changed, through make build; assert the assertion message names the option and nothing is copied or signed

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'ninja ${NINJA_VERSION} is older than the ${NINJA_MINIMUM} minimum; see docs/SIGNING.md' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a ninja reporting a version below the minimum; assert the refusal and no configure

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected Meson output at ${native_bin}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a configured directory with one C output removed after the source check; assert no assembly

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'missing ${INFO_PLIST_TEMPLATE} at repo root' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: Info.plist removed after the minimum step; assert the refusal and no copy

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'missing augments source dir at ${XPC_AUGMENTS_DIR}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: runner/augments/ removed; assert the refusal before the embed steps

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected Meson output at ${PW_RUNNER_CLIENT_BIN}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: builddir/pw-runner-client removed after the native check; assert the refusal and no client copy

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'missing ${svc_name} service dir at ${svc_dir}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: runner/Services/PWRunner removed after compile; assert the refusal and no service assembly

entries.claim: the build refuses with '${svc_name} service is missing Info.plist' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: the service Info.plist removed; assert the refusal and no service copy

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected Meson output at ${svc_host}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: builddir/PWRunner removed after the native check; assert the refusal and no host copy

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'missing entitlements plist: ${ENTITLEMENTS_PLIST}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: PolicyWitness.entitlements removed; assert the refusal after assembly and no signature (probe R3 in the plan)

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected a Mach-O to sign at ${target}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a signing list entry whose file is absent; assert the refusal and no later signature

entries.claim: the build refuses with '${target} is not a Mach-O; the signing list names only executables' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a signing list entry naming a non-Mach-O file; assert the refusal and no later signature

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'expected XPC service bundle at ${svc_bundle}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: the assembled service bundle removed before service signing; assert the refusal and no seal

entries.claim: the build refuses with '${svc_name} service is missing Entitlements.plist at ${svc_entitlements}' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: the service Entitlements.plist removed; assert the refusal and no service signature

entries.claim: Meson refuses a configured directory whose buildtype label departs from the fixed policy
entries.control: not reachable on its own: Meson derives the buildtype label from optimization and debug, whose assertions fire first (the policy control shows -Dbuildtype=debug refused by the optimization assertion); a public-path control through make build with a poisoned directory would show placement before any copy for the whole group

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'stale <copy>; run python3 docs/generate_worker_identity.py' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: an identity input edited after the first check without regeneration; assert the refusal before any signature

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'Cargo's own diagnostic' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a Cargo failure (a source that does not compile) in a disposable checkout; assert status 101 and no Meson

entries.claim: Meson refuses a configured directory whose failed departs from the fixed policy
entries.control: meson configure of a copied directory with the option changed, through make build; assert the assertion message names the option and nothing is copied or signed

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'native sources: meson introspection failed' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a build directory whose meson-info cannot be introspected after the build-directory check; assert status 2

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'codesign's own diagnostic' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a reached codesign failure (an unsigned nested helper at the seal); assert no ZIP

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'missing app bundle Contents' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: an app whose Contents directory is missing at evidence time; assert status 2 and no seal

entries.claim: the build refuses with 'codesign's own diagnostic' and does not perform the operation the refusal protects
entries.control: a tampered sealed resource before verification; assert the refusal and no ZIP
